name: 53083 · Sheboygan, WI
findings: ZIP 53083 (Sheboygan) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53083 (Sheboygan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
